independence: Authored by the implementing agent after the original evaluation and corrective implementation, before any call with these literal prompts. Separate recovery holdout, not a replacement or reclassification of the original failed set. Expected answers are never sent to the model. Not an independently authored benchmark.
acceptance_policy: At least 9/10 correct complete first-attempt supported cases, 4/4 refusals, 2/2 clarifications. Timing covers all ten supported attempts. Failed cases are never delivered as successes. Development retries cannot establish acceptance.
